<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Return stored logs for an account"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/logs/{account}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Output is a downloadable text file with one JSON log entry per line, or a plain-text notice when nothing is stored<br/><br/>Nothing is stored unless logging is enabled for the account, either with the account logs flag or the global logs.all setting. IMAP accounts record the protocol trace, Gmail API and MS Graph accounts record their API requests, and SMTP transactions are recorded for any account that sends over SMTP.
